description: Fort Honswijk is a round brick tower fort of the New Dutch Waterline, with a flat bomb-proof roof, standing in a wet moat and low earth ramparts. It is not a church. The interior is closed. It is overcast, about 10.2°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h and cloud cover about 86%. The Pyramide van Austerlitz is a different monument and is not in this frame.
